snippet.title: Sigma Survivor - Official Trailer 2
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5207520/Sigma_Survivor/

Hey everyone, Pixelgore here! The second trailer of Sigma Survivor is out!

A game like nothing you've played before: a survivor-like fused with minigames, where every minigame you win makes your hero stronger!

Discover secrets, riddles and mysteries, take on daily challenges against other players, and play ONLINE with your friends in Party Mode!

Demo available very soon, add Sigma Survivor to your wishlist so you don't miss it!
